flagged.title: CPU, Main Memory and the Fetch-Decode-Execute Cycle
flagged.reason: The video explicitly teaches that the clock and system buses are components inside the CPU, which would cause a student to lose marks on an exam question asking to identify the components of the CPU.

mark_affecting.quote: Inside the CPU: The 5 Key Components... processed by a team of five essential components: the control unit, the arithmetic logic unit, the registers, the clock, and the buses.
